current_validation.scope: Development source snapshot before evidence/STATUS summary edits; not clean candidate qualification.

earlier_campaigns: Earlier exact candidates remain untouched and continue their independent work. Their reports are retained; the corrected candidate requires a complete fresh authoritative-clone campaign.
observed_mechanism: Fault-injected clone/checkout processes exit 7, but the comparison launcher attempts dependent work. An incorrect observed checkout identity also reaches installation. Existing completed simulation commands were successful; this is a qualification failure-path defect, not observed numerical drift.
repairs: Check every preparation, installation, identity, build, regression and replay process exit before dependent work.
Record and verify the observed exact commit after each comparison checkout.
Matching physical fragments cannot qualify failed or unverified regression reports.
science: No model, coefficient, numerical algorithm, scientific output projection, tolerance, seed or campaign denominator changed.
